Description:
I recieved a request to finish the rest of stanaloona's revised bachelor's for Seasonal Cute. So here they are!

This one contains [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10022]Harvey Revised[/url], now compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetics[/url].  Download and overwrite your Seasonal Cute assets with the included ones.

All assets used were either open permission or I was granted permission to use. Assets used provided by:
stanaloona420
Poltergeister
Ailin
IronZelly

Enjoy!
